findings: Thin green edge residue is visible against dark and light backgrounds along portions of hair, skin, clothing, shoes and barbell outlines. Particularly evident throughout the female set; smaller traces appear in male frames 1–3. Illustration interiors remain intact and usable.
Thin pale, broken fringe follows portions of the hair, arms, legs, cable and ground-shadow perimeter in both return frames. It is visible on the dark background; artwork remains intact and usable.

Frame 0 has no continuous oval ground shadow (female frame 0 retains small dark patches at the feet/pulley), while frames 1–3 have an oval shadow joining the feet and pulley. This produces a small background pop at the loop boundary. Foot and pulley positions also drift slightly, without a large scale mismatch.

Thin pale, occasionally dotted fringe follows portions of the outer contours, equipment edges and shoes on the dark background. Limited in extent; no substantial exterior residue or opaque background.

Male frame 1 has visibly flatter leg/knee shading and straighter, forward-facing shoes than the other three frames, with a slightly lower head position. This produces a limited visual pop; identity and exercise remain recognizable.
Female frame 1 has a slightly higher shoe baseline than frames 0, 2 and 3 despite the standing movement, creating modest vertical anchor drift.
Small opaque white wedges remain between the hanging forearm and bench in female frame 0 and between the dumbbells above the lap in female frame 3. They remain white on the dark background.

Fine pale contour fringe is visible on dark backgrounds, with small detached flecks particularly beneath female shoes/bench and around the male frame 3 left shoe. Limited in area; illustrations remain usable.

Bench feet and planted shoes drift across each sequence, most visibly in male frames 2 and 3 compared with 0 and 1. Female bench support/adjustment-knob detail also changes from frame 0 to later frames. These stationary-object changes are separate from the intended arm raise; overall exercise remains recognizable.

White shoe sole/stripe details partially disappear into the dark background while appearing continuous against light, indicating small transparency losses within shoe artwork. Fine pale speckling traces some outlines, especially shoes. The figures remain usable; no substantial clothing holes or opaque checkerboard interiors were seen.

The planted foot and upper body drift modestly rightward from setup to later poses, more noticeably in the female sequence. Height and baseline are otherwise reasonably stable. This is limited anchor inconsistency rather than a large scale jump; some torso shift is natural for balance.
